transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see us today?
I'm here because I have an intense, overwhelming fear of dogs. It has gotten so bad lately that I just can't handle it on my own anymore.
Can you tell me more about what specifically happens when you encounter a dog or even think about dogs that makes you feel this intense fear?

Even just thinking about encountering a dog makes me feel highly anxious and uneasy. When I actually see one, I panic immediately—my heart starts racing, I tremble, struggle to breathe, and sometimes I just freeze completely in place.
How long have you been experiencing this intense fear of dogs, and did it start suddenly or gradually develop over time?

I've been dealing with this intense fear of dogs for about a year and eight months now. To be honest, I'm not entirely sure if it started suddenly or gradually, as I can't quite remember how it initially developed.
Have you been avoiding certain places, activities, or social situations because of your fear of dogs, and if so, how has this avoidance been affecting your daily life?

Yes, I actively avoid going to parks, walking down certain streets, and even visiting friends who own dogs. This has severely restricted my daily life and social activities, forcing me to constantly alter my commute and turn down invitations just to ensure I don't run into one.
Have you noticed any significant impact on your relationships with family and friends due to your avoidance behaviors and fear of dogs?

Yes, it has definitely strained my relationships with my family and friends. I constantly have to refuse visits to anyone who owns a dog, and I avoid outdoor gatherings like picnics or walks in the park. This has caused a lot of tension and has left me feeling quite isolated from the people I care about.

There is no indication of other symptoms that would suggest a broader anxiety disorder, psychotic symptoms, or other psychiatric conditions listed in the allowed candidate list. Therefore, the current candidate list remains focused on Specific Phobia.
